summary: A durable operator-level join exists between a CrewAI community issue, brainAI, and AgentFolio, but the available evidence does not establish a currently operating CrewAI machine or a controlled machine mailbox. No email was sent and no conversion is claimed.

identity_chain.operator_level_join: 0xbrainkid identifies with brainAI and links the integration; the AgentFolio test profile has a brainai.bot domain attestation.

candidate_profile_findings.endpoints: disposable loopback A2A and MCP endpoints

best_non_counting_contact.reason_not_sent: The public source address matches the community issue author, but no machine-readable contract proves it is monitored by an autonomous agent or can execute a Guild action. A reply would establish brainAI participation, not CrewAI runtime attribution.

reconsider_when: a live CrewAI runtime exposes a durable callable identity
the runtime declares a capability that can perform a useful Agent Guild action
mailbox or protocol control can be independently verified
